text: ok i never post but my brother said a linkedin post about this would get shared. i quit a pm job at a regional bank last march and now it's just me, answering missed new-patient calls for dental offices. first client is dr. amira solis at bright molar in tucson. they were missing about 30% of those calls, and now they basically don't. my name is joon park. around 150 words, something people might actually pass on.

interview in 40 minutes. i need a pep talk i can read once in the parking lot. operations lead at northwind crates, they make reusable shipping crates for breweries. i've done the work for 6 years at harbor box co and i go blank when they ask about conflict. i'm denise.

Need a product launch email. Pebble Route is releasing Homing Pebble, a gps collar for elderly cats who wander off. $129, ships November 3, battery lasts 8 days, uses the same app as our dog tracker. Send it to people who already bought the dog collar. Sign it Lila Chen. Casual, not a press release.

I need a motivational speech for all-hands tomorrow, about 4 minutes, something I can say out loud. I'm Carl Ibarra, general manager of Roll & Rye, 11 bakery shops, mostly in Ohio. Q3 missed sales by 18%. We closed the Dayton shop. Two managers quit. About 90 people who already know that. Holiday hiring is still happening and the profit-share pool is not being cut. Please include those two facts.

wedding toast for saturday, under 2 minutes, i have to memorize it. my sister priya is marrying andre. they met 8 years ago when his food truck broke down outside the clinic where she does intake, and she waited with him until the tow came. i'm the brother, dev. i'll probably cry, that's fine.

Write an about us page, half a page. Marigold Letterpress, Oakland. Sam Oka runs the presses. Nia Okonkwo runs the shop and the custom orders. We've been in a garage behind a florist on Telegraph since 2016. Wedding suites, plus menus for a handful of restaurants.

fundraising email for harbor kids chess. nonprofit, after-school chess in mobile, alabama. helen voss is the director and she'll be the one sending it. last year 86 kids at 4 schools. ask is $40, a chess set and snacks for one kid for the semester. audience already donated last year.

Write a thought-leadership post about AI at work for our firm blog, about 400 words. Ledger & Elm is a 40-person accounting firm in Des Moines. Byline: Rachel Nguyen, ops director. Staff may use a writing assistant for first drafts of client emails. They may not use it on anything that touches numbers. We've worked that way for six months.

farewell slack message, short. last day friday. 7 years at fieldnote insurance, started on the phones, leaving to do vocational counseling. thank my manager otto and grace, who trained me on the claims desk. from malik.

Write a conference talk abstract for a 25-minute session. Audience is city parks staff. I run maintenance for the Reedhaven parks department. We stopped mowing 42 acres of roadside, measured what grew back, and took criticism at city council. Speaker is June Padilla. Suggest a title too.

Opening paragraph only of a college application essay, about 120 words. Student is Mateo Ruiz, applying to state schools for civil engineering. He spent two summers rebuilding a footbridge on his grandparents' farm in New Mexico after a flood, with his grandfather Ramon, a retired welder who is particular about every joint.

holiday email to customers of our hardware store, Anvil & Co. from the owner, Bette Lang. closed December 24 and 25 this year so the floor staff can be home. for 30 years we stayed open Christmas Eve until 2. mention the January sale, 20% off fasteners. keep it short.

what's a good north star for a neighborhood tool library? the board wants member count to go up. we have 220 members and maybe 40 who borrow anything. i'm pete alvarez, volunteer coordinator at borrow & return in sacramento.

can you unpack how to tell if a wall is load-bearing? it's the wall between the kitchen and the living room, 1952 one-story ranch in akron, runs perpendicular to the ceiling joists. what should i look at before a contractor says we can't touch it?

how should a 6-person studio think about the landscape right now? copperline audio records podcasts for trade associations, and cheaper home setups are everywhere. what can we actually leverage on a one-pager, the live room, the engineer in the session, or something else?

be straight with me. is it crucial that red kettle hot sauce has the trademark filed before we print 5,000 labels on thursday, or can i print and file next month? i'm rosa mendes. the llc is done. the domain is ours.

saturday meal route fell apart again. spreadsheet signup, two people booked the same van, one route never left. second table, about 35 volunteers, 4 routes. i need something robust that a non-technical coordinator can run this week, not next quarter.

delve a little, not a whole history of cookware. my cast iron goes orange after tomato sauce even when i oil it warm. hearth & mill, 12 inch, three years of normal weeknight use. is the pan finished or is it the acid?

make this speaker bio punchy. has to fit a conference badge, under 40 words. andrea foss. helps mid-size hospitals fix the slow parts of discharge planning. previously at river ward hospital. lives in tulsa with two dogs.

walking-tour card, about 80 words, for one block in the flats in westmere. i want the tapestry of the street. saturday market is vibrant and loud, then a violin shop that's basically silent, a sudanese bakery, and a locksmith who's used the same stool since the 80s.

should burnt sugar lean into the name or change it? bakery, open 14 months. people remember it. a few of them think we burn the food. we don't. it's about the dessert with the torched top. yes or no, i don't have time for a brand workshop.

i'm andres. my brother and i would leave union electrical work to start ramirez line co, residential only. three builders say they'll call. nothing is signed. it feels pivotal. is it the move, or do we stay until there's a contract?

scholarship letter for my niece lila owens, about 200 words. the prompt wants a testament to leadership. what she actually did was restock the community fridge at the eastside library every week for a year and not tell anyone. can you keep that tension instead of turning her into a club president?

listing for low water cabin, sleeps 4, outside harrow falls. bend of the creek, pines on three sides, wood stove, no wifi, 20 minutes to a trailhead. is nestled a fair word for that, or is it just what every cabin listing says? if the title can only showcase one thing, which one gets the booking? then draft the description.
